skills.title: Values and types
skills.description: Numbers, strings, and booleans, how type() reports them, and what / really returns.

skills.title: Variables and names
skills.description: Assign with =, compare with ==, pick names that do not collide with Python's builtins.

skills.title: Control flow
skills.description: Make decisions with if, repeat with while and for, and read range's boundaries correctly.

skills.title: Functions
skills.description: Define with def, pass parameters, return values, and avoid the classic default-argument trap.

skills.title: Lists, dicts, tuples, and sets
skills.description: Store collections, index lists from zero, look dicts up by key, and mutate safely.

skills.title: Strings and formatting
skills.description: Build text with f-strings, call string methods, and remember that strings never change in place.

skills.title: Working with files
skills.description: Read and write text files with open, pick the right mode, and let with close things for you.

skills.title: Errors and exceptions
skills.description: Read a traceback from the bottom and keep programs running with try and except.

skills.title: Modules and imports
skills.description: Pull in the standard library, call functions through the module name, and guard script code.

skills.title: Testing basics
skills.description: State expectations with assert, run a test file, and read silence as success.
